title: GPT, Claude, and Gemini in one browser tab for $39.99, for life
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: The AskAnyModel AI Pro Plan puts more than 50 AI models into one workspace, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok, as a lifetime subscription for $39.99 (reg. $499).

Paying separately for ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini adds up quickly. You still end up pasting the same prompt into three tabs to see which one got it right.

Get this AskAnyModel AI Pro Plan lifetime subscription for $39.99 (reg. $499) while this price is live.

What’s unlimited and what runs on credits

The plan gives you unlimited chats with 30 standard models, including DeepSeek R1, Llama, Mistral, Qwen Coder, and Kimi K2.

For the bigger models, you get 500 credits every month. You can spend them across 19 premium options, such as GPT-5.4, Claude Opus, Claude Sonnet 5, Gemini 3 Pro, and Grok. A Gemini model with Google Search grounding is also included, for up to 300 chats a week.

Image generation on supported models doesn’t use your premium credits. You can also switch models mid-conversation without losing context.

Everything runs in Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox, so there’s nothing to install on your Mac. The same account works from your iPhone’s browser. The plan includes updates, and it’s open to both new and existing users. You need to redeem your code within 30 days of purchase.

Verified buyers rate it 4.5/5. If you’re tired of renting several AI tools every month, this is a practical way to own access to all of them.

Get this AskAnyModel AI Pro Plan lifetime subscription for $39.99 (reg. $499) before this price changes.
